description: Code-porting + transpilation + language-conversion tools and techniques — moving code (or a game) from one language / runtime / platform to another. A registry of approach SPECS (what it does, fidelity, when to use, the verification it needs), not implementations; pointers, never truth. Deterministic-first + verify-with-tests: the safe pattern is port the TESTS first as the oracle, then translate against them. Composes with capability_ladders (cost-ordered descent), chain_of_thought_contracts (show-work / verify-then-answer for an LLM port), and the verification rail.

tools.name: AST source-to-source transpiler
tools.what: parse -> typed AST -> rewrite -> emit target source
tools.fidelity: high for in-paradigm pairs (e.g. TS->JS, py2->py3)
tools.when_to_use: same-paradigm conversion with a parser for both ends
tools.verify: diff behavior on a test suite; round-trip where possible

tools.name: Language-pair converter
tools.what: a converter specialized for one source->target pair (idioms + stdlib mapping)
tools.when_to_use: a common, well-mapped pair (e.g. JS->TS, Java->Kotlin, py2->py3)
tools.verify: the pair's test suite + a lint pass

tools.name: LLM-assisted port (test-oracle gated)
tools.what: a model translates a unit; the ported TESTS are the oracle that accepts/rejects it
tools.fidelity: variable -> gated to high by the tests
tools.when_to_use: no deterministic transpiler for the pair; idiomatic rewrites needed
tools.verify: MANDATORY: port the tests first, accept only green; serves_truth=false until verified

tools.name: Transpile to native/wasm (Emscripten-class)
tools.what: compile a source language to a portable target (wasm / C / LLVM IR)
tools.when_to_use: run existing code on a new platform (browser/edge) without a rewrite

tools.name: Game / engine port
tools.what: port game logic + assets to a new engine/platform (re-implement engine calls, convert assets)
tools.when_to_use: shipping a title to a new platform; pair with an asset-conversion + a compat shim
tools.verify: frame/behavior parity tests on reference scenes

tools.name: Static recompilation / decompile-recompile
tools.what: lift a binary to IR, then recompile to a new target
tools.fidelity: high for the lifted semantics; gaps at the platform boundary
tools.when_to_use: porting where source is unavailable (legacy/games); heavyweight
tools.verify: behavior diff against the original on inputs

tools.name: Compatibility shim (port-avoidance)
tools.what: a runtime adapter so old code runs unchanged on the new platform
tools.when_to_use: porting is too costly + a shim is feasible; the highest-ROI option to check FIRST (don't reinvent)

tools.name: Test-first porting harness
tools.what: port + run the source's tests on the target as the acceptance oracle BEFORE accepting any translated unit
tools.fidelity: as good as the test coverage
tools.when_to_use: ALWAYS, as the governing wrapper around any port (esp. an LLM port)
tools.verify: the ported tests ARE the verification
